description:
Analytical equilibrium, transport and finite-strain verification.

All dynamic refinements keep final time and the other discretisation fixed.
Fixed-cloud remaps and prescribed-gradient patches deliberately bypass dynamics;
they diagnose individual operators rather than validate a full simulation.

controls.spatial: fixed dt and remap count; grid and midpoint particle quadrature refined together
controls.temporal: fixed grid, particle cloud, final time and transfer; dt and remap count vary
controls.quadrature: fixed grid, dt and final time; midpoint particles per cell varied
controls.transfer: fixed grid/cloud; repeated remaps without motion or force updates
controls.affine_patch: prescribed nodal velocity; tests finite-strain kinematics/constitutive integration, not dynamics
